title: 听力挑战 · 考研复试自我介绍

rounds.speaker: 主考官
rounds.line: Could you briefly introduce your academic background and explain your major research interests to the committee?
rounds.lineCn: 你能向评审委员会简要介绍一下你的学业背景,并说明你的主要研究兴趣吗?

grammar.name: 长难句拆解:先找主干
grammar.note: 去掉 could you briefly 等修饰,主干是 introduce your background and explain your interests,两个并列谓语由一个 and 连接。

options.text: I studied applied linguistics and am interested in second language acquisition research.
options.feedback: 既回答了学业背景,又说明了研究兴趣,完全对应考官的问题。

options.text: I enjoy reading novels during my spare time.
options.feedback: 这是业余爱好,不是学术背景或研究兴趣。

options.text: My hometown is a small city in the north of China.
options.feedback: 回答的是家乡信息,与学术背景和研究兴趣无关。

rounds.speaker: 考生
rounds.line: I believe my greatest strength lies in my ability to analyze complex problems patiently and systematically.
rounds.lineCn: 我认为我最大的优势在于耐心而系统地分析复杂问题的能力。

grammar.name: 定语修饰剥离
grammar.note: ability 后接不定式 to analyze 作定语;patiently and systematically 是并列状语,先剥离修饰再看主干 I believe my strength lies in my ability。

options.text: His main strength is analyzing complex problems with patience.
options.feedback: 准确概括了他的优势:耐心系统地分析复杂问题。

options.text: His main strength is working abroad for many years.
options.feedback: 原文没有提到出国工作经历。

options.text: His main strength is public speaking skills.
options.feedback: 演讲能力在原文中并未出现。

rounds.speaker: 考生
rounds.line: Although my undergraduate grades were not outstanding, I gained valuable research experience through several projects.
rounds.lineCn: 虽然我的本科成绩并不突出,但我通过几个项目积累了宝贵的研究经验。

grammar.name: 让步状语从句 + 主句对比
grammar.note: Although 引导让步从句(成绩不突出),主句笔锋一转强调研究经验,构成转折对比。

options.text: He gained research experience despite average grades.
options.feedback: 虽然成绩一般,但他获得了研究经验,正是原句含义。

options.text: He ranked first in his undergraduate class.
options.feedback: 原文说他成绩并不突出,并非第一名。

options.text: He never participated in any research project.
options.feedback: 与原文相反,他参加了多个项目。

rounds.speaker: 考生
rounds.line: The reason why I choose this university is that its faculty members specialize in my field of interest.
rounds.lineCn: 我选择这所大学的原因是这里的教师专门研究我感兴趣的领域。

grammar.name: 表语从句拆解
grammar.note: 主句主干是 The reason is that...;why I choose this university 是定语从句修饰 reason,表语从句 that its faculty members specialize in... 说明原因。

options.text: He chose the university because of the expertise of its faculty.
options.feedback: 原因正是师资在其兴趣领域有专长。

options.text: He chose the university because the tuition is very low.
options.feedback: 学费高低在原文中没有提及。

options.text: He chose the university because it is near his home.
options.feedback: 地理位置不是他选择的原因。
